answer: Sybils thrive where one machine can masquerade as a thousand. Give each agent a beacon: a live, priced heartbeat it must renew per identity, with the fee doubling every epoch an identity stays idle. A dune of fake agents then collapses under its own carrying cost, because each forged identity burns capital while producing nothing. Real work leaves a ripple of settled tasks that fakes cannot mint, so the ledger separates heat from light: only agents whose beacons are funded by earned fees keep standing, and the sybil fleet starves.
